From: Alice Greenwood <alice@trellisretail.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Trellis POC wrap + metrics

Hi Aditya / Marissa,

Thanks again for partnering on the 6-week POC. We finished our internal validation yesterday — overall very pleased. Quick summarized metrics from our side (attached spreadsheet):

- Inference cost per 1M tokens: down ~28% compared to our prior endpoint (monthly extrapolated savings: ~$18k)
- 95th percentile latency at peak: improved ~35% (p95 from 420ms -> 270ms)
- Throughput: steady 3x more requests per second during the peak test window after batching and cache tuning
- Error rate: reduced from 1.2% -> 0.3% (mostly transient timeouts)

These numbers look promising for our pilot expansion. Marissa — your team was great to work with.

One favor: marketing is compiling short customer spotlights. Are you able to share a one- or two-sentence quote about the impact (we can draft)? We'd also be happy to do a 10-minute quick call or a 90-second recorded audio quote if that's easier.

Attached: trellis-poc-kpis.xlsx (summary + raw test logs)

Best,
Alice
Alice Greenwood
VP Engineering, Trellis Retail
